title: Note Infinite Canvas App
description: Create a new fully-featured S technology app 'note' — an infinite canvas with text blocks, images, tables, math, pencil drawing, fully integrated with hover, selection, document, window options, VCS persistence, playground dev host, and S program registration.
summary: The React dev Note editor and infinite canvas are running on port 6080 with the managed attempt 57 guest. All nine Chromium scenarios passed, including the 21-check editor archive round trip, history and mixed archive adoption, Viewer, cancellation, erasers, geometry, and clipboard. The staged and served WebAssembly bytes agree. The verification report records the post-publication Cargo snapshot error, broader renderer TypeScript diagnostics, and two supplementary native fixture failures. Ticket-generated output was removed.
